text:
maria: quick follow-up on the precision RFC — we need a concrete plan for session-scoped/transient precision overrides that don't corrupt KV cache or cause longctx regression. thoughts?

jake: +1 we saw a drift case in prod where a short high-precision plugin bumped latency and then cache warmed wrong entries.

sophia: are we talking about per-request header or a longer-lived session flag?

maria: leaning toward ephemeral session flags ( TTL ~minutes ) that can elevate precision for a few turns, then auto-revert. must avoid reusing higher-bit cached KV for later low-precision requests.

kevin: two big risks: cache contamination (higher precision values stored then used by lower-precision inference) and padding/kv-serialization incompatibilities across quant formats.

michael: what if we namespace KV per precision mode? cheap and explicit: cache key = f"{model}:{precision}:{shard}:{input_hash}". avoids accidental reuse.

ops: that will increase cache footprint — do we have metrics on cost impact?

jake: rough calc: if 5% requests use transient fp8 and we namespace, cache dup ~5% extra. acceptable vs silent correctness bugs.

sophia: alternative: store canonical low-precision KV and keep a small transient overlay cache for elevated sessions. overlay expires with TTL. overlay size bounded by active sessions.

maria: overlay approach sounds promising. avoids full duplication. need eviction semantics and a fast lookup fallback to base.

kevin: implement lookup order: 1) overlay with (session_id, precision) 2) base cache keyed by (model, quant_profile) 3) compute. Make overlay lightweight and in-memory on serving node.

infra-bot: note: current KV serializer v2 assumes fixed quant metadata. We'll need to include precision tag in serialized header to detect incompatible blobs.

michael: yeah include a small header: `PREC:fp8;VER:2;MODEL:gptx` so runtime can detect and reject incompatible entries instead of silently using them.

ops: any change to cache format requires migration plan and a graceful roll. can we gate by runtime flag?

sophia: propose a feature flag `precision-overlay` that defaults off for canary nodes. rollout: 1) enable header parsing, 2) enable overlay lookups, 3) enable overlay writes. each step monitored.

maria: API surface: add optional header `X-Precision-Mode: transient=fp8;ttl=120s;session=abcd1234` or SDK param `precision_override({mode: "fp8", ttl_seconds: 120, session: "..."})`. must be opt-in.

jake: note: we should also expose `precision_effective` in response meta so clients can audit what ran.

kevin: on quality tradeoffs — for some prompts fp8 -> measurable hallucination increase. need gating: allow customer to attach `quality_budget:95` meaning only allow overrides if eval score stays above threshold on known suites.

maria: can we compute a cheap proxy metric at runtime? e.g., token-confidence delta vs baseline and if it drops below X, auto-revert transient mode and mark session.

sophia: probably too noisy. better: preflight check per model/profile using an offline prompt-set and a lightweight shadow-run sample to decide allowlist of prompts/customers. runtime fallback still needed.

ops: logging/telemetry: add event `precision.override.start` and `.end` with reason, session id, model, perf delta, quality delta tags. wire to console dashboards.

michael: for SDK ergonomics: `client.generate({ precision: { mode: 'transient', profile: 'fp8', ttl: 120 }})` and also queue a webhook `precision-warning` if we auto-fallback due to quality.

kevin: runtime changes summary: - overlay cache w/ TTL - serializer header to detect incompatible KV - lookup order changes - metrics hooks + feature flag rollout - API header/SDK param - response meta field

maria: decision: prototype overlay + header parsing behind `precision-overlay` flag. will run a 2-week canary on internal traffic and a small subset of beta customers.

sophia: i'll draft the follow-up RFC with config snippets, rollout steps, and telemetry dashboards.

jake: cc @ops for rollout plan and @infra for serializer work.

ops: ack. will prepare canary playbook and capacity estimate.

maria: thanks all — can we reconvene after RFC draft? I'll ping in a few days. :thumbsup:
